title: hearty tender argentinian corn bake
description: A delicious and kid-friendly argentinian dish featuring creamed corn, salty shio-cure, and a hint of floral flavor baked in a claypot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Grate the romano cheese and chop the fresh parsley in a bowl.
Boil the ears of corn until tender, then let cool.
Butter the claypot and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and pepper.
Add the unsalted butter to the bowl and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add the heavy cream to the bowl and mix until the dough comes together.
Add the grated romano cheese and chopped parsley to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Sauté the shio-cure in a pan until crispy, then crumble and set aside.
Add the boiled corn to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to the buttered claypot and top with crumbled shio-cure.
Bake the corn bake for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.
